name: domain-expert-core
description: Cross-domain task agents for architecture, troubleshooting, migrations, IaC, data governance, and security hardening. Includes ultimate-tech-stack: security-gated, open-source-preferred greenfield defaults with explicit exceptions when open source cannot safely meet the threat model. Also includes skill-builder: a multi-agent pipeline where parallel Sonnet researchers build a source-cited corpus and an Opus curator distills it into new marketplace skills. And plugin-builder: an interactive architecture pipeline one level above skill-builder that interviews the user on intent, strategizes which skills, agents, and hooks a plugin should ship, and remodels skills repos into plugin or marketplace repos.
